# Set up environment

```{r, echo = FALSE, class.source = 'foldable'}
using<-function(...) {
    libs<-unlist(list(...))
    req<-unlist(lapply(libs,require,character.only=TRUE))
    need<-libs[req==FALSE]
    if(length(need)>0){ 
        install.packages(need)
        lapply(need,require,character.only=TRUE)
    }
}

# h3 from github repo
if(!require(h3)){
    remotes::install_github("crazycapivara/h3-r")
}
```

```{r, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
using("osmextract","kableExtra","ggplot2","sf","tidyverse","knitr","h3","janitor")
options(scipen = 999)
```

# Read data

```{r}
sd <- st_read("large_data/Tranquil City Index_Sample.geojson")
```

# Filter variables

```{r}
names(sd)

kv <- c("index", "tranquilcityindex_day", "dBA_total_LQ16", "no2_conc", "pm25_conc", "greencov_perc", "bluecov_perc", "treecov_perc")

sd %>%
  select(kv) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() -> sdcsv

write_csv(sdcsv, "large_data/sdcsv.csv")
```
